name: Sodden Floor

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave

disable: DC 16 Crafting check (trained) to reinforce the compromised floorboards.

items.name: Crumble
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto any square containing the sodden floorboards.

---

Effect All squares with floorboards give way. Each creature in any of the marked squares must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save save.

Success The creature moves to the nearest safe square and avoids falling in.

Failure The creature falls 10 feet, takes 5 bludgeoning damage as a result of the fall, and is prone in the hole.

text: The floorboards here are rotting and soft, giving way and dropping anyone above into the hole below.
